english.notes: (i) This offence document should not be used after the 3rd March 2024 due to a penalty amendment made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For the basic offence applying from the 4th March 2024, see H101608. For the aggravated offence, see H101605.(ii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The reference to 12 months is to be read as a reference to 6 months in relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
